catalog/af9b599ca5acbe2a/en.text: The Doxygen contract for Thread::dispatchMessages() states that messages are delivered in the order they were posted. The actual implementation skips messages whose type or receiver does not match and calls the receiver's handler after unlocking. In a recursive call using a different filter, a later message may be delivered before a previously skipped message.

catalog/472390a7b4b7be32.text: Thread::dispatchMessages()는 이벤트 루프 외에도 해당 수신 스레드에서 명시적으로 호출하거나 핸들러에서 재귀 호출하여 남아 있는 일치 메시지를 전달할 수 있습니다. type이 Message::Type::None이면 모든 유형이 일치하고, receiver가 null이면 모든 수신자가 일치합니다. 이 함수는 thread-safe가 아니므로 해당 스레드에서만 호출해야 하며, 다른 스레드에서 호출하면 동작은 정의되지 않습니다.

catalog/472390a7b4b7be32/en.text: Thread::dispatchMessages() may deliver remaining matching messages outside the event loop when called explicitly from the receiving thread or recursively from a handler. If type is Message::Type::None, all types match, and if receiver is null, all receivers match. This function is not thread-safe, so it must be called only from the relevant thread; calling it from another thread results in undefined behavior.

catalog/5bb6744db4fc2c61.text: 소스 기반 조사 계획으로, 각 dispatch의 type, receiver, 메시지 게시 순서와 실제 전달 순서, 수신 TID와 재귀 깊이, 콜백 진입과 복귀를 기록합니다. 포인터 인자의 마지막 사용도 기록하여 호출 시점까지 유효했는지 확인하고, 메시지 포인터는 핸들러 호출이 끝난 뒤 참조를 보관하지 않아야 합니다. 이 계획은 실행 결과가 아닙니다.

catalog/5bb6744db4fc2c61/en.text: As a source-based investigation plan, record each dispatch's type and receiver, the order in which messages are posted and actually delivered, the receiving TID and recursion depth, and callback entry and return. Also record the last use of pointer arguments to check whether they remained valid until invocation, and do not retain a reference to the message pointer after the handler call ends. This plan is not an execution result.

catalog/b0e5bbc1d5d36e11.text: UVC의 정상 버퍼 반환과 STREAMOFF 성공 시 남은 버퍼 취소는 imageBufferReady에서 completeBuffer와 completeRequest를 거쳐 같은 requestCompleted 알림으로 이어질 수 있습니다. Developer는 이 슬롯에서 RequestComplete와 RequestCancelled를 구별하고 버퍼별 FrameSuccess로 영상 사용 여부를 판단해야 하며, RequestComplete에도 FrameError가 있을 수 있고 취소된 버퍼는 FrameCancelled입니다. Vendor의 장치 검증 계획은 첫 실행에서 정상 촬영하고 둘째 실행에서 미완료 요청을 남긴 채 stop()을 호출하며, 수신 루프를 처리해 제출별 알림 횟수와 미수신 여부, 요청과 버퍼 상태를 기록하는 것입니다. 다른 스레드에 큐잉된 슬롯은 stop() 반환 뒤에도 실행될 수 있습니다.

catalog/b0e5bbc1d5d36e11/en.text: Normal UVC buffer returns and cancellation of remaining buffers when STREAMOFF succeeds may both lead from imageBufferReady through completeBuffer and completeRequest to the same requestCompleted notification. In this slot, the Developer must distinguish between RequestComplete and RequestCancelled and use each buffer's FrameSuccess to determine whether to use the image; RequestComplete may also have FrameError, and cancelled buffers are FrameCancelled. The Vendor's device validation plan is to capture normally on the first run, call stop() with incomplete requests remaining on the second run, and process the receive loop to record the number of notifications for each submission, whether any were not received, and the request and buffer states. Slots queued on another thread may execute even after stop() returns.

catalog/994f565c3db1c188.text: 실행 확인 항목: 조사 계획입니다. BoundMethodBase::activatePack의 ConnectionTypeAuto 분기에서 Thread::current()와 수신 스레드인 object_->thread()가 서로 달라 type이 ConnectionTypeQueued가 된 기록을 확인하고, completeRequest가 복귀했으며 파이프라인 큐가 비어 있는데도 콜백 진입 기록이 없다면 실제 제품 애플리케이션에서 수신 스레드의 이벤트 루프가 콜백을 처리하지 않았을 가능성을 조사합니다.

catalog/994f565c3db1c188/en.text: Runtime verification item: This is an investigation plan. Check records showing that, in the ConnectionTypeAuto branch of BoundMethodBase::activatePack, Thread::current() differed from object_->thread(), the receiving thread, causing type to become ConnectionTypeQueued. If completeRequest has returned and the pipeline queue is empty but there is no record of callback entry, investigate the possibility that the receiving thread's event loop did not process the callback in the actual product application.

catalog/d8c6b27eadc105ad.text: 선택 경로를 바꾼 뒤의 조사 계획으로, 준비 대기 요청과 장치에 대기 중인 요청이 섞인 상태에서 정지하고 VIDIOC_STREAMOFF와 releaseBuffers()에 각각 실패를 주입하여 반환값과 다음 분기, 요청별 완료 횟수, 제출 순서, 큐 잔존 상태, 정지 후 재투입 여부를 기록합니다. 취소 콜백 구간에서는 doQueueRequests()에 다시 들어가는지 관찰하고, PipelineHandler::stop()이 대기 큐를 분리한 이후에도 같은 항목을 요청별로 기록합니다.

catalog/d8c6b27eadc105ad/en.text: The investigation plan after changing the selected path is to stop with requests awaiting preparation mixed with requests queued to the device, inject failures into VIDIOC_STREAMOFF and releaseBuffers() respectively, and record the return values and subsequent branches, completion count for each request, submission order, remaining queue state, and whether requests are requeued after stopping. During cancellation callbacks, the plan is to observe whether doQueueRequests() is re-entered and, even after PipelineHandler::stop() has detached the waiting queue, record the same items for each request.

catalog/f591f835fe07bf17.text: Camera::requestComplete()가 실제로 진입하면 isAccessAllowed()에 allowDisconnected=true를 전달하므로 연결 해제 여부와 별개로 상태를 검사합니다. 검사에서 읽은 상태가 CameraStopping 또는 CameraRunning이면 isAccessAllowed()는 0을 반환하고, 호출자인 Camera::requestComplete()는 requestCompleted를 발생시킵니다. 읽은 상태가 CameraAvailable, CameraAcquired 또는 CameraConfigured이면 isAccessAllowed()는 -EACCES를 반환하고, 호출자인 Camera::requestComplete()는 Fatal 로그 분기에 들어갑니다. 연결 해제 시 CameraRunning이었고 후속 완료 검사까지 CameraConfigured가 유지된 경우에도 이 분기에 해당하며, 열거값의 판정은 실제 도달성을 뜻하지 않습니다.

catalog/f591f835fe07bf17/en.text: When Camera::requestComplete() is actually entered, it passes allowDisconnected=true to isAccessAllowed(), so the state is checked regardless of whether the camera is disconnected. If the state read during the check is CameraStopping or CameraRunning, isAccessAllowed() returns 0, and its caller, Camera::requestComplete(), emits requestCompleted. If the state read is CameraAvailable, CameraAcquired, or CameraConfigured, isAccessAllowed() returns -EACCES, and its caller, Camera::requestComplete(), enters the Fatal log branch. This branch also applies if the state was CameraRunning at disconnection and CameraConfigured remained the state through the subsequent completion check; classification by enum value does not imply actual reachability.

catalog/0eefbd08f01d7524.text: 조사 계획에서는 기존 실행에서 연결 해제와 완료 검사가 각각 읽은 상태, disconnected_, isRunning()의 결과와 stop()의 반환값을 관찰합니다. 완료 함수에 진입한 경우 isAccessAllowed()의 반환값과 그다음 Fatal 로그 또는 requestCompleted 발생 분기를 확인합니다. 이는 실행한 시험이나 복구 보장이 아닌 조사 계획입니다.

catalog/0eefbd08f01d7524/en.text: The investigation plan is to observe the states read by disconnection and the completion check, respectively, in the existing execution, along with disconnected_, the result of isRunning(), and the return value of stop(). If the completion function is entered, the plan is to check the return value of isAccessAllowed() and the subsequent branch that logs a Fatal message or emits requestCompleted. This is an investigation plan, not an executed test or a guarantee of recovery.

catalog/86026f36ef02cf6b.text: 신호되지 않는 fence에 대해 timeout에서 cancel 후 prepared 발행까지의 순서와 cancelled_·prepared_를 기록하고, 준비 취소된 요청이 순번을 등록한 뒤 장치 큐 호출 대신 completeRequest()의 공통 완료 경로로 전달되는지 확인합니다. 미준비 선두, 장치 큐 한도와 앞선 Pending 요청으로 실제 통지가 지연될 수 있으므로 300ms를 촬영 또는 정지 완료 시간의 보장으로 취급하지 않으며, 중복 처리 여부, 제출 순서에 따른 반환 및 반환 시 pending 버퍼 잔존 여부를 확인합니다.

catalog/86026f36ef02cf6b/en.text: For an unsignalled fence, record the sequence from timeout through cancellation to emission of prepared, along with cancelled_ and prepared_, and check whether a request cancelled during preparation is passed to the common completion path of completeRequest() after being assigned a sequence number, instead of being passed to a device queue call. Because an unprepared request at the front of the queue, the device queue limit, and earlier Pending requests may delay actual notification, 300 ms is not treated as a guarantee of capture or stop completion time. Also check for duplicate processing, return in submission order, and whether pending buffers remain at the time of return.

catalog/257aa412129a53f7.text: cache get 성공 뒤 VIDIOC_QBUF에 음수를 주입하는 시험에서는 확보 index, ioctl ret, 이번 scope_exit의 put 횟수와 해당 항목의 free 상태, 이번 버퍼의 신규 queuedBuffers_ 등록 부재를 기록합니다. 원래 음수 ret의 전달과 공통 취소를 대조하고, 버퍼 완료가 요청을 자동 완료하지 않으며 요청은 명시적으로 완료되고 제출 순서대로 반환되는 조건에 맞춰 요청별 알림 횟수를 기록합니다. cache_ 자체 부재의 Fatal은 정상 음수 반환이나 cancelRequest 도달을 보장하지 않는 별도 경우로 다룹니다.

catalog/257aa412129a53f7/en.text: In a test that injects a negative result into VIDIOC_QBUF after a successful cache get, the plan is to record the acquired index, ioctl ret, the number of put calls by this scope_exit and the free state of the corresponding entry, and the absence of a new queuedBuffers_ registration for this buffer. The plan is to check propagation of the original negative ret and common cancellation, and record the notification count for each request in accordance with the conditions that buffer completion does not automatically complete the request, requests are completed explicitly, and they are returned in submission order. A Fatal caused by the absence of cache_ itself is treated as a separate case that does not guarantee a normal negative return or reaching cancelRequest.

catalog/1c4ddf4b516f4b9b.text: 유효하게 dequeue된 버퍼의 V4L2_BUF_FLAG_ERROR와 FrameError를 기록하고, UVC가 해당 상태를 유지한 채 completeBuffer 다음에 completeRequest를 호출하는 경로를 확인합니다. pending에서 버퍼가 한 번 제거되는 횟수와 요청의 제출·완료 통지 순서, 요청 완료 콜백까지 버퍼가 유효하게 유지되는 수명을 기록하며, 다른 취소 원인이 없을 때 가능한 RequestComplete를 FrameError와 별도로 기록합니다.

catalog/1c4ddf4b516f4b9b/en.text: The plan is to record V4L2_BUF_FLAG_ERROR and FrameError for a validly dequeued buffer and check the path where UVC calls completeBuffer followed by completeRequest while retaining that status. The plan also records the count of buffer removals from pending, which should occur once, the order of request submission and completion notifications, and the period for which the buffer remains valid through the request completion callback. Any possible RequestComplete when there is no other cause of cancellation is recorded separately from FrameError.

catalog/8e7183ba71e9cc0f.text: 정상 정지에서는 waitingRequests_ 분리 후 장치 요청의 취소 완료, 분리된 요청의 순번 등록과 제출 순서에 따른 반환을 추적하고, 요청별·버퍼별 완료 횟수와 queuedRequests_·waitingRequests_의 잔존 및 정지 중 재투입을 기록합니다. STREAMOFF 실패와 releaseBuffers 실패를 별도 사례로 두고 각각의 ret, state_, cache_, queuedBuffers_, queuedRequests_, ASSERT 도달 및 정지 중 재투입을 기록하며, 실패 시 0 반환이나 모든 버퍼 반환을 기대하지 않고, STREAMOFF 실패 후 cache_ reset과 잔존 notifier·큐가 겹치면 알려진 인덱스의 후속 DQBUF에서 cache_->put 접근이 안전하게 처리되는지 확인합니다.

catalog/8e7183ba71e9cc0f/en.text: For a normal stop, the plan is to track the completion of device request cancellation after waitingRequests_ is detached, the assignment of sequence numbers to the detached requests, and their return in submission order, and to record completion counts per request and per buffer, whether queuedRequests_ and waitingRequests_ remain, and whether requests are requeued during the stop. STREAMOFF failure and releaseBuffers failure are treated as separate cases; for each, the plan is to record ret, state_, cache_, queuedBuffers_, queuedRequests_, whether ASSERT is reached, and whether requests are requeued during the stop. The plan does not expect a return value of 0 or the return of all buffers on failure, and checks whether access to cache_->put is handled safely on a subsequent DQBUF for a known index if a cache_ reset after STREAMOFF failure coincides with a remaining notifier and queue.

catalog/ebb21ae4828c4416.text: 허용된 doQueueRequests 재진입에서는 pop과 투입 순서 및 request별 투입 횟수를 기록해 중복 투입이 없는지 확인하고, 같은 함수의 콜백 중첩 진입은 별도 허용 문서 없이 하지 않습니다. Direct와 지연된 Queued 수신의 현재·수신 스레드, cookie, sequence, 콜백 진입·복귀, stop 전후와 객체 수명을 기록하며, 실행 중 접근 검사를 통과한 Camera::stop이 PipelineHandler::stop을 ConnectionTypeBlocking으로 호출하는 정상 경로에 해당 실행이 도달했는지와 Blocking 반환 및 별도 Queued 수신자의 마지막 사용·종료를 구분해 확인하고, Signal 발신자가 포인터·참조의 유효성을 유지하며 요청 소유자가 삭제·재사용 전에 모든 지연 수신자의 마지막 사용을 완료·해제 협의로 동기화하는지 검증하고 요청 완료 신호나 한 핸들러의 복귀를 모든 지연 수신자의 사용 종료로 간주하지 않습니다.

catalog/ebb21ae4828c4416/en.text: For permitted doQueueRequests reentry, the pop and submission order and the number of submissions per request are recorded to check for duplicate submissions; nested entry into the same function from a callback is not performed without separate documentation permitting it. The current and receiver threads for Direct and delayed Queued reception, cookie, sequence, callback entry and return, events before and after stop, and object lifetimes are recorded. The investigation separately checks whether the execution reached the normal path in which Camera::stop, having passed the access check while running, calls PipelineHandler::stop with ConnectionTypeBlocking, and distinguishes the Blocking return from each separate Queued receiver's last use and termination. It verifies that the Signal sender keeps pointers and references valid and that the request owner synchronizes every delayed receiver's last use through completion and release coordination before deletion or reuse; a request completion signal or the return of one handler is not treated as the end of use by all delayed receivers.

catalog/cc224802283336cf.text: 호출자는 stop()을 카메라 상태에 영향을 주는 다른 함수와 동기화해야 하며, 정지 뒤 게시된 메서드가 실제 실행되는 경우는 별도로 분류해 요청의 중복 완료와 재투입 여부를 기록 항목으로 대조합니다. 요청을 완료한 파이프라인 핸들러는 completeRequest() 반환 뒤 해당 요청에 접근해서는 안 되며, 호출자는 요청 완료 콜백까지 버퍼의 유효성을 보장해야 하므로, 완료 통지와 함께 stop()의 대기 요청 부재 및 PipelineHandler::stop()의 queuedRequests_·waitingRequests_ 비어 있음에 대한 ASSERT 조건을 대조합니다.

catalog/cc224802283336cf/en.text: The caller must synchronize stop() with other functions that affect the camera state. Cases in which a method posted after stopping actually executes are classified separately, and duplicate request completions and whether requests are requeued are checked against the recorded items. The pipeline handler that completed a request must not access that request after completeRequest() returns, and the caller must ensure that the buffer remains valid until the request completion callback. Accordingly, completion notifications are checked alongside the ASSERT conditions for the absence of pending requests in stop() and for queuedRequests_ and waitingRequests_ being empty in PipelineHandler::stop().

catalog/dac400d006409a26.text: 서로 다른 Request와 버퍼로 동시 제출하면서 Request 식별자와 cookie, 호출 스레드별 queueRequest 시작·반환값, Thread::postMessage의 mutex 안 list_ 추가 순서, PipelineHandler::queueRequest 진입과 waitingRequests_ 등록 순서를 추가 계측해 연관 기록합니다. doQueueRequest의 Request sequence와 queuedRequests_ 선두에서의 requestComplete 통지 순서, bufferReady·bufferCompleted·requestCompleted 신호 발생 및 특정 연결의 콜백 진입·복귀를 각각 기록하며, Request sequence와 FrameMetadata sequence의 동일성이나 서로 다른 스레드의 호출 시작에 관한 전역 순서는 가정하지 않습니다.

catalog/dac400d006409a26/en.text: While submitting concurrently with distinct Request instances and buffers, additional instrumentation records and correlates Request identifiers and cookies, queueRequest start and return values for each calling thread, the order of list_ additions within the mutex in Thread::postMessage, and the order of entry into PipelineHandler::queueRequest and registration in waitingRequests_. The plan records separately the Request sequence in doQueueRequest, the order of requestComplete notifications from the front of queuedRequests_, emission of the bufferReady, bufferCompleted, and requestCompleted signals, and callback entry and return for a specific connection. It assumes neither equality between the Request sequence and the FrameMetadata sequence nor a global order of call starts across different threads.

catalog/ab5a077174eb0aa4.text: 공개 가상 CPU 프로브를 3회 실행했으며, 실행당 RequestComplete로 보고된 요청은 4개, RequestCancelled로 보고된 요청은 4개이고 콜백은 24회입니다. 전체 콜백은 72회입니다. Ubuntu WSL2의 Virtual2 공개 가상 프로브에서 Auto·Queued 콜백은 수신 객체의 메인 스레드에서, Direct 콜백은 그와 다른 스레드에서 실행됐습니다. 정지 취소 요청의 콜백 진입·복귀 근처 표식은 Auto·Queued에서 stop-return 뒤에, Direct에서 stop-enter와 stop-return 사이에 관찰됐으며, stop-enter·stop-return은 camera->stop() 호출 앞뒤의 애플리케이션 표식으로 함수 내부의 정확한 명령 경계는 아닙니다.

catalog/ab5a077174eb0aa4/en.text: The public virtual CPU probe was run three times. In each run, four requests were reported as RequestComplete, four as RequestCancelled, and there were 24 callbacks. There were 72 callbacks in total. In the public Virtual2 virtual probe on Ubuntu WSL2, Auto and Queued callbacks ran on the receiving object's main thread, while Direct callbacks ran on a different thread. Markers near callback entry and return for requests cancelled during stop were observed after stop-return for Auto and Queued, and between stop-enter and stop-return for Direct. The stop-enter and stop-return markers are application markers before and after the camera->stop() call, not exact instruction boundaries inside the function.

catalog/d34c36501fec090f.text: 반환 근처 표식은 returned.fetch_add(1)과 지역 객체 소멸 전에 기록되므로 실제 C++ 함수의 반환 완료나 명령 수준 반환 추적을 증명하지 않습니다. Ubuntu WSL2의 Virtual2 가상 프로브에서 CPU 전용 memfd 버퍼와 신호가 없는 eventfd 시험 입력을 사용해 실제 애플리케이션 콜백을 관찰했습니다. DMA 동기화 및 제공자 오류는 보존했으며 DMA 동기화, 물리 카메라·센서·ISP 촬영, 다른 애플리케이션과 사내 Camera HAL은 검증하지 않았습니다.

catalog/d34c36501fec090f/en.text: The near-return marker is recorded before returned.fetch_add(1) and local object destruction, so it does not prove that the actual C++ function has finished returning or trace the return at instruction level. Actual application callbacks were observed in the Virtual2 virtual probe on Ubuntu WSL2 using CPU-only memfd buffers and unsignalled eventfd test input. DMA synchronization and provider errors were retained; DMA synchronization, physical camera, sensor, and ISP capture, other applications, and the in-house Camera HAL were not validated.

catalog/b8cc77f025f147f6.text: Camera::queueRequest()는 요청 검사를 마친 뒤 ConnectionTypeQueued를 지정해 invokeMethod로 PipelineHandler::queueRequest를 호출하고, 그 호출 뒤에 0을 반환합니다. 이 0은 invokeMethod 호출 뒤의 반환값이며, 요청 완료는 카메라가 requestCompleted 신호로 별도로 알립니다.

catalog/b8cc77f025f147f6/en.text: After completing the request checks, Camera::queueRequest() calls PipelineHandler::queueRequest through invokeMethod, specifying ConnectionTypeQueued, and returns 0 after that call. This 0 is the return value after the invokeMethod call; the camera separately signals request completion through the requestCompleted signal.

catalog/cd6e66c2ce8b9b8e.text: Request::addBuffer는 버퍼에 대한 참조를 요청에 저장합니다. 호출자는 요청 완료 콜백이 호출될 때까지 해당 버퍼가 유효하게 남아 있도록 보장해야 합니다. Request::addBuffer가 성공하면 유효한 Fence의 소유권은 buffer(FrameBuffer)로 이동합니다. 이때 fence는 buffer로 옮겨집니다.

catalog/cd6e66c2ce8b9b8e/en.text: Request::addBuffer stores a reference to the buffer in the request. The caller must ensure that the buffer remains valid until the request completion callback is invoked. If Request::addBuffer succeeds, ownership of the valid Fence moves to buffer (FrameBuffer). At that point, fence is moved to buffer.

catalog/9fcbfb9a4a908932.text: registerRequest는 요청이 생성될 때 호출되어 파이프라인 핸들러가 해당 요청에 필요한 일회성 초기화를 수행할 기회를 제공합니다. prepared 신호에 연결된 콜백은 doQueueRequests 함수를 호출합니다. PipelineHandler::queueRequest는 요청이 가리키는 카메라의 내부 waitingRequests_에 요청을 추가한 뒤 prepare에 시간 인자 300ms를 전달합니다.

catalog/9fcbfb9a4a908932/en.text: registerRequest is called when a request is created, giving the pipeline handler an opportunity to perform any one-time initialization needed for that request. The callback connected to the prepared signal calls the doQueueRequests function. PipelineHandler::queueRequest adds the request to the internal waitingRequests_ of the camera referenced by the request, then passes the time argument 300ms to prepare.

catalog/78aaa1777c1bf749.text: completeRequest가 반환된 뒤에는 파이프라인 핸들러가 해당 요청에 접근해서는 안 됩니다. completeRequest는 요청이 애플리케이션에 제출 순서대로 반환되도록 보장합니다. 파이프라인 핸들러는 완료된 요청에 대해 순서 제약 없이 completeRequest를 호출할 수 있습니다. while 루프는 맨 앞 요청이 RequestPending 상태이면 break를 실행하여 반복을 중단합니다.

catalog/78aaa1777c1bf749/en.text: After completeRequest returns, the pipeline handler must not access the request. completeRequest ensures that requests are returned to the application in submission order. The pipeline handler may call completeRequest on any completed request without ordering constraints. If the first request has RequestPending status, the while loop executes break to stop iterating.

catalog/f1dedb5923f2bda3.text: completeRequest는 대기 중인 요청을 파이프라인에 큐잉할 수 있도록 마지막에 doQueueRequests(camera)를 호출합니다. completeBuffer와 completeRequest는 모두 CameraManager 스레드에서 호출해야 합니다.

catalog/f1dedb5923f2bda3/en.text: completeRequest calls doQueueRequests(camera) at the end so that waiting requests can be queued to the pipeline. Both completeBuffer and completeRequest must be called from the CameraManager thread.

catalog/78f4b235ce673294.text: completeRequest()의 조사에서는 큐 선두 요청의 상태가 Request::RequestPending인지 관찰합니다. 해당 상태이면 break로 반복문을 벗어나 선두 요청이 큐에 남고, 제출 순서에 따라 뒤에서 이미 완료된 요청도 requestComplete()로 반환되지 않는 분기를 살펴봅니다. 선두가 해당 상태가 아니면 ASSERT(!req->hasPendingBuffers());가 대기 중인 버퍼가 없다는 부정 조건을 검사한 뒤 pop_front()로 선두를 제거하고 requestComplete(req)를 호출하는 순서를 관찰합니다.

catalog/78f4b235ce673294/en.text: In the investigation of completeRequest(), observe whether the state of the front request in the queue is Request::RequestPending. If it is, observe that the loop exits through break and the front request remains in the queue, and examine the branch in which an already completed request later in submission order is not returned through requestComplete(). If the front is not in that state, observe the order in which ASSERT(!req->hasPendingBuffers());, which checks the negated condition that no buffers are pending, is followed by removing the front with pop_front() and calling requestComplete(req).

catalog/9694654234940909.text: Camera::queueRequest()는 캡처할 요청을 카메라에 접수합니다. 이 함수는 thread-safe이며 호출자는 카메라가 Running 상태일 때만 호출해야 합니다. 카메라 연결이 끊겼으면 -ENODEV를 반환하고, 연결이 유지된 상태에서 Running 상태가 아니면 -EACCES를 반환합니다.

catalog/9694654234940909/en.text: Camera::queueRequest() queues a request to the camera for capture. The function is thread-safe, and the caller must call it only when the camera is in the Running state. If the camera is disconnected, Camera::queueRequest() returns -ENODEV; if the camera remains connected but is not in the Running state, Camera::queueRequest() returns -EACCES.

catalog/0f72a2583215cf11.text: 애플리케이션은 createRequest()로 만든 요청을 접수하기 전에 캡처 버퍼를 하나 이상 채워야 합니다. 검사를 통과한 Camera::queueRequest()는 patchControlList()를 호출하고 PipelineHandler::queueRequest()를 큐 방식으로 호출한 뒤 0을 반환합니다. 요청이 접수된 후 카메라는 requestCompleted 신호로 완료를 알립니다.

catalog/0f72a2583215cf11/en.text: The application must fill a request created with createRequest() with at least one capture buffer before queuing it. After passing the checks, Camera::queueRequest() calls patchControlList(), invokes PipelineHandler::queueRequest() through a queued call, and returns 0. After the request is queued, the camera signals its completion through requestCompleted.

catalog/bfb4f007f8fe3276.text: Camera::queueRequest는 patchControlList로 요청의 AeEnable을 전처리한 뒤 ConnectionTypeQueued를 사용해 PipelineHandler::queueRequest에 요청을 전달합니다. 카메라 상태는 함수가 끝날 때까지 바뀔 수 있으며, PipelineHandler::queueRequest가 이 상태 변경을 처리하므로 이 부분에는 잠금이 필요하지 않습니다. CameraManager 스레드에서 호출되는 PipelineHandler::queueRequest는 요청을 waitingRequests_에 넣은 뒤 prepare(300ms)를 시작합니다. 소스 주석에 따르면 준비 단계에서 요청이 실패하면 해당 요청을 취소합니다.

catalog/bfb4f007f8fe3276/en.text: Camera::queueRequest preprocesses the request's AeEnable using patchControlList and then passes the request to PipelineHandler::queueRequest using ConnectionTypeQueued. The camera state may change until the function ends, and no locking is needed for this part because PipelineHandler::queueRequest handles the state change. Called from the CameraManager thread, PipelineHandler::queueRequest puts the request in waitingRequests_ and then starts prepare(300ms). According to the source comment, if a request fails during preparation, that request is cancelled.

catalog/2eace40003f58d25.text: 조건 분기, 반복 횟수와 실제 실행 스레드는 이 호출 목록만으로 확정할 수 없습니다. 가상 호출 후보는 실제 객체에 따라 선택됩니다. 예약 표시는 인자로 전달한 메서드 대상을 뜻하며, 비동기 실행을 보증하지 않습니다. 호출부의 연결 방식과 동기화 계약을 확인해야 합니다.

catalog/2eace40003f58d25/en.text: Conditional branches, repeat counts, and the actual execution thread cannot be determined from this call list alone. Virtual call candidates are selected according to the actual object. The scheduled marker indicates the method target passed as an argument and does not guarantee asynchronous execution. You must check the call site's connection method and synchronization contract.

overview/boundary/synchronization.text:
Functions that affect the camera state as defined below are generally not
 * synchronized with each other by the Camera class. The caller is responsible
 * for ensuring their synchronization if necessary.
 *
 * \subsection Camera States

overview/boundary/completion.text:
\brief Signal request completion
 * \param[in] request The request that has completed
 *
 * The pipeline handler shall call this function to notify the \a camera that
 * the request has completed. The request is no longer managed by the pipeline
 * handler and shall not be accessed once this function returns.
 *
 * This function ensures that requests will be returned to the application in
 * submission order, the pipeline handler may call it on any complete request
 * without any ordering constraint.
 *
 * \context This function shall be called from the CameraManager thread.
 */
void PipelineHandler::completeRequest

vendor-integration/request/completion-co.text:
\brief Complete a buffer for a request
 * \param[in] request The request the buffer belongs to
 * \param[in] buffer The buffer that has completed
 *
 * This function shall be called by pipeline handlers to signal completion of
 * the \a buffer part of the \a request. It notifies applications of buffer
 * completion and updates the request's internal buffer tracking. The request
 * is not completed automatically when the last buffer completes to give
 * pipeline handlers a chance to perform any operation that may still be
 * needed. They shall complete requests explicitly with completeRequest().
 *
 * \context This function shall be called from the CameraManager thread.
 *
 * \return True if all buffers contained in the request have completed, false
 * otherwise
 */
bool PipelineHandler::completeBuffer

camera-model/concurrency/create.text:
\brief Create a request object for the camera
 * \param[in] cookie Opaque cookie for application use
 *
 * This function creates an empty request for the application to fill with
 * buffers and parameters, and queue for capture.
 *
 * The \a cookie is stored in the request and is accessible through the
 * Request::cookie() function at any time. It is typically used by applications
 * to map the request to an external resource in the request completion
 * handler, and is completely opaque to libcamera.
 *
 * The ownership of the returned request is passed to the caller, which is
 * responsible for deleting it. The request may be deleted in the completion
 * handler, or reused after resetting its state with Request::reuse().
 *
 * \context This function is \threadsafe. It may only be called when the camera
 * is in the Configured or Running state as defined in \ref camera_operation.
 *
 * \return A pointer to the newly created request, or nullptr on error
 */
std::unique_ptr<Request> Camera::createRequest(uint64_t cookie)

camera-model/concurrency/start.text:
\brief Start capture from camera
 * \param[in] controls Controls to be applied before starting the Camera
 *
 * Start the camera capture session, optionally providing a list of controls to
 * apply before starting. Once the camera is started the application can queue
 * requests to the camera to process and return to the application until the
 * capture session is terminated with \a stop().
 *
 * \context This function may only be called when the camera is in the
 * Configured state as defined in \ref camera_operation, and shall be
 * synchronized by the caller with other functions that affect the camera
 * state.
 *
 * \return 0 on success or a negative error code otherwise
 * \retval -ENODEV The camera has been disconnected from the system
 * \retval -EACCES The camera is not in a state where it can be started
 */
int Camera::start(const ControlList *controls)

vendor-integration/boundary/repeat.text:
\fn PipelineHandler::match(DeviceEnumerator *enumerator)
 * \brief Match media devices and create camera instances
 * \param[in] enumerator The enumerator providing all media devices found in the
 * system
 *
 * This function is the main entry point of the pipeline handler. It is called
 * by the camera manager with the \a enumerator passed as an argument. It shall
 * acquire from the \a enumerator all the media devices it needs for a single
 * pipeline, create one or multiple Camera instances and register them with the
 * camera manager.
 *
 * If all media devices needed by the pipeline handler are found, they must all
 * be acquired by a call to MediaDevice::acquire(). This function shall then
 * create the corresponding Camera instances, store them internally, and return
 * true. Otherwise it shall not acquire any media device (or shall release all
 * the media devices is has acquired by calling MediaDevice::release()) and
 * return false.
 *
 * If multiple instances of a pipeline are available in the system, the
 * PipelineHandler class will be instantiated once per instance, and its match()
 * function called for every instance. Each call shall acquire media devices for
 * one pipeline instance, until all compatible media devices are exhausted.
 *
 * If this function returns true, a new instance of the pipeline handler will
 * be created and its match() function called.
 *
 * \context This function is called from the CameraManager thread.
 *
 * \return true if media devices have been acquired and camera instances
 * created, or false otherwise

\class Signal
 * \brief Generic signal and slot communication mechanism
 *
 * Signals and slots are a language construct aimed at communication between
 * objects through the observer pattern without the need for boilerplate code.
 * See http://doc.qt.io/qt-6/signalsandslots.html for more information.
 *
 * Signals model events that can be observed from objects unrelated to the event
 * source. Slots are functions that are called in response to a signal. Signals
 * can be connected to and disconnected from slots dynamically at runtime. When
 * a signal is emitted, all connected slots are called sequentially in the order
 * they have been connected.
 *
 * Signals are defined with zero, one or more typed parameters. They are emitted
 * with a value for each of the parameters, and those values are passed to the
 * connected slots.
 *
 * Slots are normal static or class member functions. In order to be connected
 * to a signal, their signature must match the signal type (taking the same
 * arguments as the signal and returning void).
 *
 * Connecting a signal to a slot results in the slot being called with the
 * arguments passed to the emit() function when the signal is emitted. Multiple
 * slots can be connected to the same signal, and multiple signals can connected
 * to the same slot.
 *
 * When a slot belongs to an instance of the Object class, the slot is called
 * in the context of the thread that the object is bound to. If the signal is
 * emitted from the same thread, the slot will be called synchronously, before
 * Signal::emit() returns. If the signal is emitted from a different thread,
 * the slot will be called asynchronously from the object's thread's event
 * loop, after the Signal::emit() function returns, with a copy of the signal's
 * arguments. The emitter shall thus ensure that any pointer or reference
 * passed through the signal will remain valid after the signal is emitted.
 *
 * Duplicate connections between a signal and a slot are not expected and use of
 * the Object class to manage signals will enforce this restriction.
 */

// SPDX-License-Identifier: CC-BY-SA-4.0

/**
 * \page thread-safety Reentrancy and Thread-Safety
 *
 * Through the documentation, several terms are used to define how classes and
 * their member functions can be used from multiple threads.
 *
 * - A **reentrant** function may be called simultaneously from multiple
 *   threads if and only if each invocation uses a different instance of the
 *   class. This is the default for all member functions not explictly marked
 *   otherwise.
 *
 * - \anchor thread-safe A **thread-safe** function may be called
 *   simultaneously from multiple threads on the same instance of a class. A
 *   thread-safe function is thus reentrant. Thread-safe functions may also be
 *   called simultaneously with any other reentrant function of the same class
 *   on the same instance.
 *
 * \internal
 * - \anchor thread-bound A **thread-bound** function may be called only from
 *   the thread that the class instances lives in (see section \ref
 *   thread-objects). For instances of classes that do not derive from the
 *   Object class, this is the thread in which the instance was created. A
 *   thread-bound function is not thread-safe, and may or may not be reentrant.
 * \endinternal
 *
 * Neither reentrancy nor thread-safety, in this context, mean that a function
 * may be called simultaneously from the same thread, for instance from a
 * callback invoked by the function. This may deadlock and isn't allowed unless
 * separately documented.
 *
 * \if internal
 * A class is defined as reentrant, thread-safe or thread-bound if all its
 * member functions are reentrant, thread-safe or thread-bound respectively.
 * \else
 * A class is defined as reentrant or thread-safe if all its member functions
 * are reentrant or thread-safe respectively.
 * \endif
 * Some member functions may additionally be documented as having additional
 * thread-related attributes.
 *
 * Most classes are reentrant but not thread-safe, as making them fully
 * thread-safe would incur locking costs considered prohibitive for the
 * expected use cases.
 */

\page thread Thread Support
 *
 * libcamera supports multi-threaded applications through a threading model that
 * sets precise rules to guarantee thread-safe usage of the API. Additionally,
 * libcamera makes internal use of threads, and offers APIs that simplify
 * interactions with application threads. Careful compliance with the threading
 * model will ensure avoidance of race conditions.
 *
 * Every thread created by libcamera is associated with an instance of the
 * Thread class. Those threads run an internal event loop by default to
 * dispatch events to objects. Additionally, the main thread of the application
 * (defined as the thread that calls CameraManager::start()) is also associated
 * with a Thread instance, but has no event loop accessible to libcamera. Other
 * application threads are not visible to libcamera.
 *
 * \section thread-objects Threads and Objects
 *
 * Instances of the Object class and all its derived classes are thread-aware
 * and are bound to the thread they are created in. They are said to *live* in
 * a thread, and they interact with the event loop of their thread for the
 * purpose of message passing and signal delivery. Messages posted to the
 * object with Object::postMessage() will be delivered from the event loop of
 * the thread that the object lives in. Signals delivered to the object, unless
 * explicitly connected with ConnectionTypeDirect, will also be delivered from
 * the object thread's event loop.
 *
 * All Object instances created internally by libcamera are bound to internal
 * threads. As objects interact with thread event loops for proper operation,
 * creating an Object instance in a thread that has no internal event loop (such
 * as the main application thread, or libcamera threads that have a custom main
 * loop), prevents some features of the Object class from being used. See
 * Thread::exec() for more details.
 *
 * \section thread-signals Threads and Signals
 *
 * When sent to a receiver that does not inherit from the Object class, signals
 * are delivered synchronously in the thread of the sender. When the receiver
 * inherits from the Object class, delivery is by default asynchronous if the
 * sender and receiver live in different threads. In that case, the signal is
 * posted to the receiver's message queue and will be delivered from the
 * receiver's event loop, running in the receiver's thread. This mechanism can
 * be overridden by selecting a different connection type when calling
 * Signal::connect().
 */

\enum FrameMetadata::Status
 * \brief Define the frame completion status
 * \var FrameMetadata::FrameSuccess
 * The frame has been captured with success and contains valid data. All fields
 * of the FrameMetadata structure are valid.
 * \var FrameMetadata::FrameError
 * The frame data is partly or fully corrupted, missing or otherwise invalid.
 * This can for instance indicate a hardware transmission error, or invalid data
 * produced by the sensor during its startup phase. The sequence and timestamp
 * fields of the FrameMetadata structure is valid, all the other fields may be
 * invalid.
 * \var FrameMetadata::FrameCancelled
 * Capture stopped before the frame completed. The frame data is not valid. All
 * fields of the FrameMetadata structure but the status field are invalid.
 * \var FrameMetadata::FrameStartup
 * The frame has been successfully captured. However, the IPA is in a
 * cold-start or reset phase and will result in image quality parameters
 * producing unusable images. Applications are recommended to not consume these
 * frames. All other fields of the FrameMetadata structure are valid.
 */

\fn PipelineHandler::queueRequest()
 * \brief Queue a request
 * \param[in] request The request to queue
 *
 * This function queues a capture request to the pipeline handler for
 * processing. The request is first added to the internal list of waiting
 * requests which have to be prepared to make sure they are ready for being
 * queued to the pipeline handler.
 *
 * The queue of waiting requests is iterated and up to \a
 * maxQueuedRequestsDevice_ prepared requests are passed to the pipeline handler
 * in the same order they have been queued by calling this function.
 *
 * If a Request fails during the preparation phase or if the pipeline handler
 * fails in queuing the request to the hardware the request is cancelled.
 *
 * Keeping track of queued requests ensures automatic completion of all requests
 * when the pipeline handler is stopped with stop(). Request completion shall be
 * signalled by the pipeline handler using the completeRequest() function.
 *
 * \context This function is called from the CameraManager thread.
 */
void PipelineHandler::queueRequest(Request *request)
{
	LIBCAMERA_TRACEPOINT(request_queue, request);

	Camera *camera = request->_d()->camera();
	Camera::Private *data = camera->_d();
	data->waitingRequests_.push(request);

	request->_d()->prepare(300ms);
}

vendor-integration/integration/camera.text:
An application needs to perform a sequence of operations on a camera before
 * it is ready to process requests. The camera needs to be acquired and
 * configured to prepare the camera for capture. Once started the camera can
 * process requests until it is stopped. When an application is done with a
 * camera, the camera needs to be released.

vendor-integration/integration/restart.text:
An application may start and stop a camera multiple times as long as it is
 * not released. The camera may also be reconfigured.

findings.condition: 연결 해제 허용 여부와 현재 상태의 지정 범위 포함 여부에 따른 분기입니다.
findings.timing: 연결 해제 검사가 상태 범위 검사보다 먼저 실행됩니다.
findings.scope: 소스의 분기와 코드 위치에 관한 설명입니다.
findings.reason: 한영 동료 문장과 대상 문장은 동일한 조건과 반환 순서를 설명하며 소스와 일치합니다.
findings.claim_quote: 기존 `Camera::Private::isAccessAllowed` 호출의 조사에서는 먼저 `allowDisconnected`가 거짓이고 `disconnected_`가 참일 때 `-ENODEV`를 반환하는 선행 분기를 구분합니다. 그 밖에는 `currentState`와 `low`, `high`의 범위 비교 및 범위 안의 `0` 반환을 살펴보고, 범위 밖에서는 `ASSERT`, 오류 로그, `-EACCES` 반환의 코드 위치를 순서대로 확인합니다.

findings.condition: validate 결과가 Valid와 다를 때의 반환을 확인하는 계획입니다.
findings.timing: 접근 검사를 통과한 뒤 설정 검증 시점입니다.
findings.scope: 실행 확인 계획이며 시험이 수행되었다는 주장이 아닙니다.
findings.reason: 소스는 해당 비교와 -EINVAL 분기를 보여 주며 한영 계획도 같은 조건을 유지합니다.
findings.claim_quote: 조사 계획에서는 `Camera::configure`의 `config->validate()` 결과를 `CameraConfiguration::Valid`와 비교하고, 결과가 다를 때 `-EINVAL`을 반환하는지 함께 기록할 수 있습니다.

findings.condition: 접근 및 설정 검증을 통과하고 파이프라인 설정 호출이 0을 반환한 뒤 stream이 null인 경우입니다.
findings.timing: 각 설정의 stream을 확인하는 반복문 안입니다.
findings.scope: 해당 null 분기와 명시된 호출 결과에 한정됩니다.
findings.reason: 소스의 Fatal 로그, 활성 스트림 초기화 및 -EINVAL 반환 경로와 한영 문장이 일치합니다.
findings.claim_quote: 조사할 때 `Camera::configure()`에서 접근 검사와 설정 검증을 통과한 뒤 `PipelineHandler::configure`의 반환값이 0인 경우, 각 `cfg.stream()`의 결과인 `stream`과 null 검사 결과를 관찰합니다. `stream`이 null이면 Fatal 로그 `Pipeline handler failed to update stream configuration`과 `activeStreams_.clear()` 다음의 `-EINVAL` 반환 경로를 확인합니다.

findings.condition: 기본 allowDisconnected 값이 false인 Running 상태 검사입니다.
findings.timing: 요청 내용 검사 전입니다.
findings.scope: 연결 해제와 상태 접근 검사 및 음수 반환 전달입니다.
findings.reason: 기본 인자와 접근 검사 구현이 두 오류 조건을 뒷받침하며 한영 동료 문장과도 일치합니다.
findings.claim_quote: queueRequest는 먼저 isAccessAllowed(CameraRunning)를 호출하며, 연결이 해제된 경우 -ENODEV를, 연결이 해제되지 않았지만 Running 상태가 아닌 경우 -EACCES를 반환합니다. 반환값이 음수이면 요청 내용을 검사하기 전에 그 값을 그대로 반환합니다.

findings.condition: 접근 검사 통과 후 생성 카메라, 요청 상태, control 정보 맵을 차례로 검사합니다.
findings.timing: 버퍼 검사 전에 실행됩니다.
findings.scope: 각 검사에서의 명시적 오류 반환입니다.
findings.reason: 요청의 infoMap과 현재 카메라의 controls 주소를 비교하는 같은 동작이며 한영 문장과 소스의 조건 및 반환값이 일치합니다.
findings.claim_quote: 접근 검사를 통과한 뒤 요청을 생성한 카메라가 현재 카메라와 다르면 -EXDEV를 반환합니다. 다음으로 요청 상태가 RequestPending이 아니면 -EINVAL을 반환합니다. 이어서 controls().infoMap()을 카메라의 controls() 주소와 비교하여 controls 목록을 다른 목록으로 덮어쓰지 못하게 검사하며, 일치하지 않으면 -EINVAL을 반환합니다.

findings.condition: 버퍼 맵이 비었거나 포함된 스트림이 활성 스트림 집합에 없는 경우입니다.
findings.timing: 앞선 요청 검사 후 빈 맵 검사 다음에 스트림 검사가 실행됩니다.
findings.scope: 각 검사에서의 -EINVAL 반환입니다.
findings.reason: 대상과 한영 동료 문장의 조건 및 순서가 소스와 일치합니다.
findings.claim_quote: 버퍼 맵이 비어 있으면 해당 검사에서 -EINVAL을 반환합니다. 그다음 각 버퍼의 스트림을 검사하여 `activeStreams_`에 없는 스트림이 있으면 -EINVAL을 반환합니다.

findings.condition: 앞선 모든 검사를 통과한 경우입니다.
findings.timing: AeEnable 전처리 후 queued 호출을 예약하고 0을 반환합니다.
findings.scope: 예약과 함수 반환이며 예약된 작업의 완료 보장은 아닙니다.
findings.reason: 한영 동료 문장과 소스가 동일한 호출 순서와 반환을 나타냅니다.
findings.claim_quote: 모든 앞선 검사를 통과하면 patchControlList로 AeEnable을 전처리한 뒤 `PipelineHandler::queueRequest`를 ConnectionTypeQueued로 예약하고 0을 반환합니다.

findings.condition: 요청 처리에 사용할 버퍼 메모리가 없는 경우의 API 반환 계약입니다.
findings.actor: API 주석과 Camera::queueRequest의 보이는 함수 본문입니다.
findings.timing: 요청 제출 시점입니다.
findings.scope: 주석의 -ENOMEM 계약과 본문의 직접 반환 분기를 구분합니다.
findings.reason: 주석은 -ENOMEM을 명시하지만 보이는 본문에는 이를 직접 반환하는 분기가 없으며 한영 문장도 이 구분을 유지합니다.
findings.claim_quote: 주석은 요청을 처리할 버퍼 메모리가 없을 때 -ENOMEM을 반환한다고 설명합니다. 구현에는 -ENOMEM을 직접 반환하는 분기가 없습니다.

findings.condition: 유효한 스트림, 중복 스트림 및 버퍼에 남은 펜스에 관한 API와 구현 조건입니다.
findings.timing: 버퍼 추가 시 검사하며 호출자의 의무는 요청 완료 콜백까지 지속됩니다.
findings.scope: 버퍼 참조와 반환 계약이며 콜백 실행이나 소유권 이전을 보장하는 주장은 아닙니다.
findings.reason: API의 유효 스트림 계약과 구현의 null 검사 및 두 -EEXIST 분기를 구분해 정확하게 설명합니다.

sources.source_quote:
\brief Add a FrameBuffer with its associated Stream to the Request
 * \param[in] stream The stream the buffer belongs to
 * \param[in] buffer The FrameBuffer to add to the request
 * \param[in] fence The optional fence
 *
 * A reference to the buffer is stored in the request. The caller is responsible
 * for ensuring that the buffer will remain valid until the request complete
 * callback is called.
 *
 * A request can only contain one buffer per stream. If a buffer has already
 * been added to the request for the same stream, this function returns -EEXIST.
 *
 * A Fence can be optionally associated with the \a buffer.
 *
 * When a valid Fence is provided to this function, \a fence is moved to \a
 * buffer and this Request will only be queued to the device once the
 * fences of all its buffers have been correctly signalled. Ownership of the
 * fence will only be taken in case of success, otherwise the fence will
 * be left unmodified.
 *
 * If the \a fence associated with \a buffer isn't signalled, the request will
 * fail after a timeout. The buffer will still contain the fence, which
 * applications must retrieve with FrameBuffer::releaseFence() before the buffer
 * can be reused in another request. Attempting to add a buffer that still
 * contains a fence to a request will result in this function returning -EEXIST.
 *
 * \sa FrameBuffer::releaseFence()
 *
 * \return 0 on success or a negative error code otherwise
 * \retval -EEXIST The request already contains a buffer for the stream
 *  or the buffer still references a fence
 * \retval -EINVAL The buffer does not reference a valid Stream
 */
int Request::addBuffer(const Stream *stream, FrameBuffer *buffer,

findings.claim_quote: addBuffer는 버퍼를 해당 `Stream`과 연결하여 요청에 참조를 저장하며, 호출자는 요청 완료 콜백까지 버퍼가 유효하도록 보장해야 합니다. API 계약에서 버퍼가 유효한 `Stream`을 참조하지 않으면 -EINVAL을 반환하며, 구현은 stream이 nullptr인 경우를 확인하고, 같은 `Stream`의 버퍼가 이미 요청에 있거나 버퍼가 여전히 펜스를 참조하면 -EEXIST를 반환합니다.

findings.condition: 접근 검사 실패와 이후 요청 검사의 각 실패 조건 및 API 주석의 반환 조건입니다.
findings.timing: queued 호출을 예약하기 전의 검사와 반환입니다.
findings.scope: 명시적 분기와 API 주석의 -ENOMEM 계약을 구분합니다.
findings.reason: 축약된 controls 호출은 문맥상 요청의 정보 맵과 카메라 controls를 식별하며, 관련 한영 동료 문장 및 소스와 반환 의미가 일치합니다.
findings.claim_quote: queued 호출 전에 isAccessAllowed 검사가 음수 ret을 반환하면 그 값을 그대로 반환하고, 다른 카메라가 만든 요청에는 -EXDEV를 반환합니다. 요청 상태가 RequestPending이 아니거나 controls().infoMap()이 &controls()와 다르거나 버퍼가 없거나 비활성 `Stream`이 포함되면 -EINVAL을 반환합니다. API 주석의 반환 계약은 카메라 연결 해제에 -ENODEV, 실행 상태가 아닐 때 -EACCES, 요청을 처리할 버퍼 메모리가 부족할 때 -ENOMEM을 명시하지만, 함수 본문에는 -ENOMEM을 직접 반환하는 분기가 없습니다.

findings.condition: 게시된 완료 호출이 실제로 CameraConfigured 상태에서 requestComplete에 도달한다는 조건입니다.
findings.timing: 조건으로 제시된 대기 큐 분리 이후 완료 호출 시점입니다.
findings.scope: 조건부 코드 경로이며 해당 순서나 상태 도달이 실제 실행되었다는 보장은 아닙니다.
findings.reason: 연결 해제 거부만 건너뛰는 인자와 열거형 상태 순서에 따라 Configured는 허용 범위 밖이며 Fatal 로그 경계에 도달합니다.
findings.claim_quote: `Camera::requestComplete()`는 `isAccessAllowed()`에 `CameraStopping`부터 `CameraRunning`까지의 범위와 `allowDisconnected=true`를 전달하며, 이 인자는 연결 해제 거부만 건너뛰고 상태 범위 검사는 유지합니다. 게시된 호출이 대기 큐 분리 뒤 실행되고 요청 완료가 `CameraConfigured` 상태에서 `Camera::requestComplete()`에 도달하면 범위 검사에서 `-EACCES`가 반환되어 `Trying to complete a request when stopped` Fatal 로그 경계에 도달합니다.

findings.condition: 인덱스 획득 후 플레인 부족 또는 수 불일치와 비연속 조건을 주입하며 UVC의 버퍼 제출 경로에 도달하는 시험입니다.
findings.actor: V4L2VideoDevice, UVC 파이프라인 및 요청 취소 경로입니다.
findings.timing: QBUF 이전 검증 실패 후 반환과 취소를 관찰하는 미실행 시험입니다.
findings.scope: 해당 버퍼와 요청의 관찰 계획이며 실제 콜백 실행이나 전체 control 적용을 주장하지 않습니다.
findings.reason: 두 검증 분기는 guard 해제 전에 반환하고 QBUF 및 신규 등록에 도달하지 않습니다. UVC가 음수 반환을 전달하면 공통 경로가 요청을 취소하고 대기 버퍼 및 요청 완료를 처리합니다.
findings.claim_quote: 미실행 시험 2에서 인덱스를 얻은 뒤 플레인 수 부족과 수 불일치·비연속 조건을 각각 주입합니다. 각각 `-EINVAL`, 해당 인덱스의 guard put, QBUF 호출 0회와 이번 버퍼의 신규 등록 부재를 기록합니다. 요청별로 음수 반환의 전달과 `cancelRequest`에 따른 대기 버퍼 취소·완료 알림 및 요청 완료를 기록하며, 전체 제어 적용이나 롤백을 가정하지 않습니다.

findings.condition: The completion function is entered and the stated state is read.
findings.timing: At the completion access check, including the stated post-disconnect case.
findings.scope: State-branch analysis; enum membership does not establish reachability.
findings.reason: The allowed range, disconnected override, signal path and Fatal branch match the supplied code. The peer claims address separate disconnect, release and start events.
findings.claim_quote: `Camera::requestComplete()`가 실제로 진입하면 `isAccessAllowed()`에 `allowDisconnected=true`를 전달하므로 연결 해제 여부와 별개로 상태를 검사합니다. 검사에서 읽은 상태가 `CameraStopping` 또는 `CameraRunning`이면 `isAccessAllowed()`는 0을 반환하고, 호출자인 `Camera::requestComplete()`는 `requestCompleted`를 발생시킵니다. 읽은 상태가 `CameraAvailable`, `CameraAcquired` 또는 `CameraConfigured`이면 `isAccessAllowed()`는 `-EACCES`를 반환하고, 호출자인 `Camera::requestComplete()`는 Fatal 로그 분기에 들어갑니다. 연결 해제 시 `CameraRunning`이었고 후속 완료 검사까지 `CameraConfigured`가 유지된 경우에도 이 분기에 해당하며, 열거값의 판정은 실제 도달성을 뜻하지 않습니다.

findings.condition: Disconnect and the subsequent release are serialized.
findings.timing: During disconnect and a later release call.

sources.source_quote:
\brief Create a request object for the camera
 * \param[in] cookie Opaque cookie for application use
 *
 * This function creates an empty request for the application to fill with
 * buffers and parameters, and queue for capture.
 *
 * The \a cookie is stored in the request and is accessible through the
 * Request::cookie() function at any time. It is typically used by applications
 * to map the request to an external resource in the request completion
 * handler, and is completely opaque to libcamera.
 *
 * The ownership of the returned request is passed to the caller, which is
 * responsible for deleting it. The request may be deleted in the completion
 * handler, or reused after resetting its state with Request::reuse().
 *
 * \context This function is \threadsafe. It may only be called when the camera
 * is in the Configured or Running state as defined in \ref camera_operation.
 *
 * \return A pointer to the newly created request, or nullptr on error
 */
std::unique_ptr<Request> Camera::createRequest(uint64_t cookie)

\brief Add a FrameBuffer with its associated Stream to the Request
 * \param[in] stream The stream the buffer belongs to
 * \param[in] buffer The FrameBuffer to add to the request
 * \param[in] fence The optional fence
 *
 * A reference to the buffer is stored in the request. The caller is responsible
 * for ensuring that the buffer will remain valid until the request complete
 * callback is called.
 *
 * A request can only contain one buffer per stream. If a buffer has already
 * been added to the request for the same stream, this function returns -EEXIST.
 *
 * A Fence can be optionally associated with the \a buffer.
 *
 * When a valid Fence is provided to this function, \a fence is moved to \a
 * buffer and this Request will only be queued to the device once the
 * fences of all its buffers have been correctly signalled. Ownership of the
 * fence will only be taken in case of success, otherwise the fence will
 * be left unmodified.
 *
 * If the \a fence associated with \a buffer isn't signalled, the request will
 * fail after a timeout. The buffer will still contain the fence, which
 * applications must retrieve with FrameBuffer::releaseFence() before the buffer
 * can be reused in another request. Attempting to add a buffer that still
 * contains a fence to a request will result in this function returning -EEXIST.
 *
 * \sa FrameBuffer::releaseFence()
 *
 * \return 0 on success or a negative error code otherwise
 * \retval -EEXIST The request already contains a buffer for the stream
 *  or the buffer still references a fence
 * \retval -EINVAL The buffer does not reference a valid Stream
 */
int Request::addBuffer(const Stream *stream, FrameBuffer *buffer,

findings.claim_quote: createRequest의 반환 타입은 std::unique_ptr<Request>이며, 새로 생성된 빈 Request 객체를 가리키는 포인터를 반환합니다. 오류가 발생하면 nullptr을 반환합니다. addBuffer는 버퍼를 해당 Stream과 연결하여 요청에 참조를 저장하며, 호출자는 요청 완료 콜백까지 버퍼가 유효하도록 보장해야 합니다. API 계약에서 버퍼가 유효한 Stream을 참조하지 않으면 -EINVAL을 반환하며, 구현은 stream이 nullptr인 경우를 확인하고, 같은 Stream의 버퍼가 이미 요청에 있거나 버퍼가 여전히 펜스를 참조하면 -EEXIST를 반환합니다.

findings.reason: The translation preserves the caller obligation and distinguishes the API contract from the null-stream implementation check.

request-lifecycle.md/stop-depth/93b54ed6.text: 연결 해제 뒤 직렬화된 새 `Camera::start()` 호출은 기본 연결 해제 검사에서 `-ENODEV`를 반환하므로 `CameraRunning`을 저장하는 경로에 도달하지 않습니다. `CameraAcquired`와 `CameraAvailable`은 상태 열거값이며, 이 값만으로 해당 상태에서 정상 잔여 촬영 요청이 도착했는지는 알 수 없습니다. 조사 계획으로 각 기존 호출 시점의 상태와 `disconnected_`, 접근 검사 반환값 및 다음 분기를 확인합니다.

catalog/30dfbf116f8ce266/en.text: The return type of createRequest is std::unique_ptr<Request>, and createRequest returns a pointer to a newly created empty Request object. If an error occurs, createRequest returns nullptr. addBuffer associates the buffer with its corresponding Stream and stores a reference in the request; the caller must ensure that the buffer remains valid until the request completion callback. Under the API contract, addBuffer returns -EINVAL if the buffer does not reference a valid Stream; the implementation checks whether stream is nullptr and returns -EEXIST if a buffer for the same Stream is already in the request or the buffer still references a fence.

catalog/110310b2f4575d77.text: queued 호출 전에 isAccessAllowed 검사가 음수 ret을 반환하면 그 값을 그대로 반환하고, 다른 카메라가 만든 요청에는 -EXDEV를 반환합니다. 요청 상태가 RequestPending이 아니거나 controls().infoMap()이 &controls()와 다르거나 버퍼가 없거나 비활성 Stream이 포함되면 -EINVAL을 반환합니다. API 주석의 반환 계약은 카메라 연결 해제에 -ENODEV, 실행 상태가 아닐 때 -EACCES, 요청을 처리할 버퍼 메모리가 부족할 때 -ENOMEM을 명시하지만, 함수 본문에는 -ENOMEM을 직접 반환하는 분기가 없습니다. PipelineHandler::queueRequest()와 PipelineHandler::queueRequestDevice()는 모두 CameraManager 스레드에서 호출됩니다.

catalog/110310b2f4575d77/en.text: Before the queued call, if the isAccessAllowed check returns a negative ret, Camera::queueRequest() returns that value unchanged; for a request created by another camera, Camera::queueRequest() returns -EXDEV. If the request status is not RequestPending, controls().infoMap() differs from &controls(), there are no buffers, or an inactive Stream is included, Camera::queueRequest() returns -EINVAL. The API comment's return contract specifies -ENODEV for a disconnected camera, -EACCES when the camera is not running, and -ENOMEM when insufficient buffer memory is available to handle the request, but the function body has no branch that directly returns -ENOMEM. Both PipelineHandler::queueRequest() and PipelineHandler::queueRequestDevice() are called from the CameraManager thread.

catalog/ff5b5b559c839b3e.text: Camera::requestComplete()는 isAccessAllowed()에 CameraStopping부터 CameraRunning까지의 범위와 allowDisconnected=true를 전달하며, 이 인자는 연결 해제 거부만 건너뛰고 상태 범위 검사는 유지합니다. 게시된 호출이 대기 큐 분리 뒤 실행되고 요청 완료가 CameraConfigured 상태에서 Camera::requestComplete()에 도달하면 범위 검사에서 -EACCES가 반환되어 Trying to complete a request when stopped Fatal 로그 경계에 도달합니다.

catalog/ff5b5b559c839b3e/en.text: Camera::requestComplete() passes the range from CameraStopping through CameraRunning and allowDisconnected=true to isAccessAllowed(); this argument bypasses only rejection due to disconnection and retains the state range check. If a posted call executes after the waiting queue is detached and request completion reaches Camera::requestComplete() in the CameraConfigured state, the range check returns -EACCES, reaching the Trying to complete a request when stopped Fatal log boundary.

catalog/48c347abb30b898e.text: processControls는 각 processControl의 반환값을 검사하지 않고 구성한 ControlList를 setControls에 전달한 뒤 그 반환값을 반환합니다. V4L2Device::setControls는 빈 목록에 0을 반환하고, 미등록 제어나 일반 검증 오류에는 -EINVAL을 반환하며, 특정 제어의 쓰기 실패에는 error_idx 앞의 제어만 대상으로 updateControls를 호출하고 -EIO를 반환합니다. 조사 계획에서는 원래 호출의 반환값을 확인하고, ioctl이 실패한 경우 error_idx와 그 앞의 제어 상태를 관찰합니다.

catalog/48c347abb30b898e/en.text: processControls passes the ControlList constructed without checking the return value of each processControl to setControls and then returns the value returned by that call. V4L2Device::setControls returns 0 for an empty list, returns -EINVAL for an unregistered control or a general validation error, and, if writing a specific control fails, calls updateControls for only the controls before error_idx and returns -EIO. The investigation plan is to check the return value of the original call and, if ioctl fails, observe error_idx and the state of the controls before it.

catalog/292b1af275ab2436.text: V4L2VideoDevice::queueBuffer는 cache 인덱스를 확보한 뒤 planes.size()가 numV4l2Planes보다 작으면 버퍼의 연속성과 관계없이 -EINVAL을 반환합니다. 플레인이 더 많으면 두 번째 검사는 비연속 버퍼에서 -EINVAL을 반환하고, 연속 버퍼는 두 검사를 통과합니다. 플레인 수가 같으면 두 검사 분기는 반환을 일으키지 않습니다.

catalog/292b1af275ab2436/en.text: After obtaining a cache index, V4L2VideoDevice::queueBuffer returns -EINVAL if planes.size() is less than numV4l2Planes, regardless of whether the buffer is contiguous. If there are more planes, the second check returns -EINVAL for a non-contiguous buffer, while a contiguous buffer passes both checks. If the plane counts are equal, neither check branch causes a return.

catalog/bc9dd8dd01a7c4c2.text: 두 -EINVAL 반환에서는 scope_exit가 현재 인덱스로 cache_->put을 호출해 해당 cache 항목을 비어 있는 상태로 표시합니다. 이 반환 경로는 VIDIOC_QBUF ioctl과 이번 버퍼의 queuedBuffers_ 등록에 도달하지 않습니다. 두 검사를 통과해도 이후 VIDIOC_QBUF의 성공이 보장되지는 않습니다.

catalog/bc9dd8dd01a7c4c2/en.text: For both -EINVAL returns, scope_exit calls cache_->put with the current index, marking the corresponding cache entry as empty. These return paths do not reach the VIDIOC_QBUF ioctl or the registration of this buffer in queuedBuffers_. Passing both checks does not guarantee that the subsequent VIDIOC_QBUF will succeed.

catalog/f591f835fe07bf17.text: Camera::requestComplete()가 실제로 진입하면 isAccessAllowed()에 allowDisconnected=true를 전달하므로 연결 해제 여부와 별개로 상태를 검사합니다. 검사에서 읽은 상태가 CameraStopping 또는 CameraRunning이면 isAccessAllowed()는 0을 반환하고, 호출자인 Camera::requestComplete()는 requestCompleted를 발생시킵니다. 읽은 상태가 CameraAvailable, CameraAcquired 또는 CameraConfigured이면 isAccessAllowed()는 -EACCES를 반환하고, 호출자인 Camera::requestComplete()는 Fatal 로그 분기에 들어갑니다. 연결 해제 시 CameraRunning이었고 후속 완료 검사까지 CameraConfigured가 유지된 경우에도 이 분기에 해당하며, 열거값의 판정은 실제 도달성을 뜻하지 않습니다.

catalog/f591f835fe07bf17/en.text: When Camera::requestComplete() is actually entered, it passes allowDisconnected=true to isAccessAllowed(), so the state is checked regardless of whether the camera is disconnected. If the state read during the check is CameraStopping or CameraRunning, isAccessAllowed() returns 0, and its caller, Camera::requestComplete(), emits requestCompleted. If the state read is CameraAvailable, CameraAcquired, or CameraConfigured, isAccessAllowed() returns -EACCES, and its caller, Camera::requestComplete(), enters the Fatal log branch. This branch also applies if the state was CameraRunning at disconnection and CameraConfigured remained the state through the subsequent completion check; classification by enum value does not imply actual reachability.

catalog/50f003ffcbaee31c.text: Camera::Private::disconnect()는 상태가 CameraRunning이면 CameraConfigured로 바꾸고, CameraStopping이면 상태를 바꾸지 않으며 disconnected_를 참으로 설정합니다. 연결 해제 뒤 직렬화된 Camera::release()는 연결 해제를 허용하여 CameraAvailable부터 CameraConfigured까지 접근을 검사하고, 검사 결과가 음수이면 -EACCES는 -EBUSY로 바꾸고 나머지는 그대로 반환합니다. 검사를 통과하면 isAcquired()가 참일 때 PipelineHandler::release를 호출한 뒤 CameraAvailable을 저장합니다.

catalog/50f003ffcbaee31c/en.text: Camera::Private::disconnect() changes the state to CameraConfigured if it is CameraRunning, leaves the state unchanged if it is CameraStopping, and sets disconnected_ to true. After disconnection, a serialized call to Camera::release() allows disconnection and checks access for states from CameraAvailable through CameraConfigured; if the check returns a negative value, the function changes -EACCES to -EBUSY and returns other values unchanged. If the check passes, the function calls PipelineHandler::release when isAcquired() is true, then stores CameraAvailable.

catalog/744c2ee0d5b9bc1b.text: 연결 해제 뒤 직렬화된 새 Camera::start() 호출은 기본 연결 해제 검사에서 -ENODEV를 반환하므로 CameraRunning을 저장하는 경로에 도달하지 않습니다. CameraAcquired와 CameraAvailable은 상태 열거값이며, 이 값만으로 해당 상태에서 정상 잔여 촬영 요청이 도착했는지는 알 수 없습니다. 조사 계획으로 각 기존 호출 시점의 상태와 disconnected_, 접근 검사 반환값 및 다음 분기를 확인합니다.

catalog/744c2ee0d5b9bc1b/en.text: A new serialized Camera::start() call after disconnection returns -ENODEV at the default disconnection check and therefore does not reach the path that stores CameraRunning. CameraAcquired and CameraAvailable are state enumeration values; those values alone do not reveal whether normal residual capture requests arrived in those states. The investigation plan is to check the state and disconnected_ at the time of each existing call, the access check return value, and the subsequent branch.

catalog/01df93de98338777.text: 미실행 시험 2에서 인덱스를 얻은 뒤 플레인 수 부족과 수 불일치·비연속 조건을 각각 주입합니다. 각각 -EINVAL, 해당 인덱스의 guard put, QBUF 호출 0회와 이번 버퍼의 신규 등록 부재를 기록합니다. 요청별로 음수 반환의 전달과 cancelRequest에 따른 대기 버퍼 취소·완료 알림 및 요청 완료를 기록하며, 전체 제어 적용이나 롤백을 가정하지 않습니다.

catalog/01df93de98338777/en.text: In unexecuted test 2, the plan is to inject insufficient plane count and mismatched plane count with non-contiguity as separate conditions after obtaining an index. For each, the plan is to record -EINVAL, the guard put for that index, zero QBUF calls, and the absence of a new registration for this buffer. For each request, the plan is to record propagation of the negative return, cancellation and completion notification of pending buffers due to cancelRequest, and request completion, without assuming that all controls were applied or rolled back.

catalog/ddb293231666c195.text: Request::addBuffer()는 먼저 !stream 조건을 확인하고, 참이면 "Invalid stream reference" 오류 로그를 남긴 뒤 -EINVAL을 반환합니다. 다음으로 buffer->_d()->fence()가 남아 있으면 -EEXIST를 반환하므로, fence가 남아 있는 버퍼는 이 단계에서 등록되지 않습니다. 마지막으로 bufferMap_.try_emplace(stream, buffer)의 inserted가 false이면, 로그 "FrameBuffer already set for stream"과 함께 -EEXIST를 반환합니다.

catalog/ddb293231666c195/en.text: Request::addBuffer() first checks whether !stream is true. If it is, the error "Invalid stream reference" is logged, and -EINVAL is returned. Next, if buffer->_d()->fence() still exists, -EEXIST is returned, so a buffer that still has a fence is not registered at this stage. Finally, if inserted of bufferMap_.try_emplace(stream, buffer) is false, the log "FrameBuffer already set for stream" is written, and -EEXIST is returned.

catalog/5eb765350991d1d6.text: !stream 검사, fence 검사, inserted 검사를 모두 통과하고 bufferMap_.try_emplace가 inserted가 true인 경우에만 buffer->_d()->setRequest(this)와 _d()->pending_.insert(buffer)가 이 순서대로 실행됩니다. 이 두 줄 뒤에는 fence 설정 분기가 이어지고, 함수는 return 0;으로 끝납니다. 애플리케이션은 createRequest()로 요청을 만든 뒤 queueRequest를 호출하기 전에 그 요청에 캡처 버퍼를 하나 이상 채워야 하며, 버퍼가 없는 요청은 큐에 넣지 않고 거부됩니다. Camera::queueRequest는 접근 검사에서 반환하지 않고 생성 카메라 검사에 도달한 경우, 요청을 생성한 카메라가 현재 카메라와 다르면 -EXDEV를 반환합니다.

catalog/5eb765350991d1d6/en.text: buffer->_d()->setRequest(this) and _d()->pending_.insert(buffer) execute in that order only if the !stream check, fence check, and inserted check all pass and bufferMap_.try_emplace has inserted set to true. A fence-setting branch follows these two lines, and the function ends with return 0;. After creating a request with createRequest(), the application must fill that request with at least one capture buffer before calling queueRequest; requests with no buffers are rejected without being queued. If Camera::queueRequest reaches the check for the camera that created the request without returning during the access check, and the camera that created the request differs from the current camera, the function returns -EXDEV.

catalog/a7747997070fb5e3.text: Camera::queueRequest는 접근 검사와 요청을 생성한 카메라 검사를 통과해 상태 검사에 도달한 경우, request->status()가 Request::RequestPending과 일치하지 않으면 -EINVAL을 반환합니다. Camera::queueRequest()는 접근, 요청을 생성한 카메라, 요청 상태 검사에서 반환하지 않고 controls 검사에 도달한 경우, request->controls().infoMap()이 Camera::controls()의 주소와 다르면 -EINVAL을 반환합니다.

catalog/a7747997070fb5e3/en.text: If Camera::queueRequest passes the access check and the check for the camera that created the request and reaches the status check, the function returns -EINVAL if request->status() does not match Request::RequestPending. If Camera::queueRequest() reaches the controls check without returning during the access, request-creating camera, or request status checks, the function returns -EINVAL if request->controls().infoMap() differs from the address of Camera::controls().

catalog/79804a3061ffd09f.text: Camera::queueRequest가 앞선 접근·요청 생성 카메라·요청 상태·controls 검사를 통과해 이 검사에 도달하면, buffers 목록이 비어 있는 경우 -EINVAL을 반환합니다. 앞선 검사에서는 접근 검사 결과가 음수이면 그 값을 반환하고, 요청을 만든 카메라가 다르면 -EXDEV를, 요청 상태나 controls 검사가 실패하면 -EINVAL을 반환합니다. Camera::queueRequest가 앞선 검사와 빈 버퍼 검사를 통과해 스트림 순회에 도달한 경우, 요청의 각 스트림이 activeStreams_에 포함되어 있는지 검사하고 포함되지 않은 스트림이 있으면 -EINVAL을 반환합니다.

catalog/79804a3061ffd09f/en.text: If Camera::queueRequest passes the preceding access, request-creating camera, request status, and controls checks and reaches this check, the function returns -EINVAL if the buffers list is empty. In the preceding checks, if the access check result is negative, the function returns that value; if the camera that created the request differs from the current camera, the function returns -EXDEV; and if the request status or controls check fails, the function returns -EINVAL. If Camera::queueRequest passes the preceding checks and the empty-buffer check and reaches the stream iteration, the function checks whether each stream in the request is included in activeStreams_ and returns -EINVAL if any stream is not included.

\brief Add a FrameBuffer with its associated Stream to the Request
 * \param[in] stream The stream the buffer belongs to
 * \param[in] buffer The FrameBuffer to add to the request
 * \param[in] fence The optional fence
 *
 * A reference to the buffer is stored in the request. The caller is responsible
 * for ensuring that the buffer will remain valid until the request complete
 * callback is called.
 *
 * A request can only contain one buffer per stream. If a buffer has already
 * been added to the request for the same stream, this function returns -EEXIST.
 *
 * A Fence can be optionally associated with the \a buffer.
 *
 * When a valid Fence is provided to this function, \a fence is moved to \a
 * buffer and this Request will only be queued to the device once the
 * fences of all its buffers have been correctly signalled. Ownership of the
 * fence will only be taken in case of success, otherwise the fence will
 * be left unmodified.
 *
 * If the \a fence associated with \a buffer isn't signalled, the request will
 * fail after a timeout. The buffer will still contain the fence, which
 * applications must retrieve with FrameBuffer::releaseFence() before the buffer
 * can be reused in another request. Attempting to add a buffer that still
 * contains a fence to a request will result in this function returning -EEXIST.
 *
 * \sa FrameBuffer::releaseFence()
 *
 * \return 0 on success or a negative error code otherwise
 * \retval -EEXIST The request already contains a buffer for the stream
 *  or the buffer still references a fence
 * \retval -EINVAL The buffer does not reference a valid Stream
 */
int Request::addBuffer(const Stream *stream, FrameBuffer *buffer,

request-lifecycle/journey/create.text:
\brief Create a request object for the camera
 * \param[in] cookie Opaque cookie for application use
 *
 * This function creates an empty request for the application to fill with
 * buffers and parameters, and queue for capture.
 *
 * The \a cookie is stored in the request and is accessible through the
 * Request::cookie() function at any time. It is typically used by applications
 * to map the request to an external resource in the request completion
 * handler, and is completely opaque to libcamera.
 *
 * The ownership of the returned request is passed to the caller, which is
 * responsible for deleting it. The request may be deleted in the completion
 * handler, or reused after resetting its state with Request::reuse().
 *
 * \context This function is \threadsafe. It may only be called when the camera
 * is in the Configured or Running state as defined in \ref camera_operation.
 *
 * \return A pointer to the newly created request, or nullptr on error
 */
std::unique_ptr<Request> Camera::createRequest(uint64_t cookie)

findings.condition: The example changes the generated configuration; configure proceeds past the access check.
findings.actor: The application requests and checks values; UVC validates; Camera configures.
findings.timing: Defaults precede the request and validation; Camera revalidates after clearing associations.
findings.scope: One Viewfinder configuration and the general validation status contract.
findings.reason: The example, validation outcomes, caller check and configure rejection are supported. The Korean and English catalog peers preserve the same conditions.

sources.source_quote:
In the example application, create a new configuration variable and use the
``Camera::generateConfiguration`` function to produce a ``CameraConfiguration``
for the single ``StreamRole::Viewfinder`` role.

.. code:: cpp

   std::unique_ptr<CameraConfiguration> config = camera->generateConfiguration( { StreamRole::Viewfinder } );

The generated ``CameraConfiguration`` has a ``StreamConfiguration`` instance for
each ``StreamRole`` the application requested. Each of these has a default size
and format that the camera assigned, and a list of supported pixel formats and
sizes.

The code below accesses the first and only ``StreamConfiguration`` item in the
``CameraConfiguration`` and outputs its parameters to standard output.

.. code:: cpp

   StreamConfiguration &streamConfig = config->at(0);

With an initialized ``CameraConfiguration``, an application can make changes to
the parameters it contains, for example, to change the width and height, use the
following code:

.. code:: cpp

   streamConfig.size.width = 640;
   streamConfig.size.height = 480;

If an application changes any parameters, it must validate the configuration
before applying it to the camera using the ``CameraConfiguration::validate()``
function. If the new values are not supported by the ``Camera`` device, the
validation process adjusts the parameters to what it considers to be the closest
supported values.

The ``validate`` function returns a :doxy-pub:`CameraConfiguration::Status`
which applications shall check to see if the Pipeline Handler adjusted the

\fn CameraConfiguration::validate()
 * \brief Validate and possibly adjust the camera configuration
 *
 * This function adjusts the camera configuration to the closest valid
 * configuration and returns the validation status.
 *
 * \todo Define exactly when to return each status code. Should stream
 * parameters set to 0 by the caller be adjusted without returning Adjusted ?
 * This would potentially be useful for applications but would get in the way
 * in Camera::configure(). Do we need an extra status code to signal this ?
 *
 * \todo Handle validation of buffers count when refactoring the buffers API.
 *
 * \return A CameraConfiguration::Status value that describes the validation
 * status.
 * \retval CameraConfiguration::Invalid The configuration is invalid and can't
 * be adjusted. This may only occur in extreme cases such as when the
 * configuration is empty.
 * \retval CameraConfiguration::Adjusted The configuration has been adjusted
 * and is now valid. Parameters may have changed for any stream, and stream
 * configurations may have been removed. The caller shall check the
 * configuration carefully.
 * \retval CameraConfiguration::Valid The configuration was already valid and
 * hasn't been adjusted.

findings.claim_quote: 앱은 `Camera::generateConfiguration()`으로 `Viewfinder` 구성 하나를 만들고 기본 크기와 픽셀 포맷을 확인한 뒤, 예시로 640×480을 요청하고 `validate()`를 호출해야 합니다. UVC 검증은 `tryFormat`을 시험하며 장치 열기나 시험이 실패하면 `Invalid`를 반환합니다. `Adjusted`는 구성이 조정되어 유효해졌다는 뜻이며 어느 스트림의 매개변수든 바뀌거나 스트림 구성이 제거되었을 수 있으므로, 앱은 검증 후 크기와 픽셀 포맷을 읽고 변경을 받아들일지 판단해야 합니다. 이후 `Camera::configure()`는 접근이 허용되면 스트림 연결을 지우고 다시 검증하며, 결과가 `Valid`가 아니면 `-EINVAL`을 반환합니다.

\brief Configure the camera prior to capture
 * \param[in] config The camera configurations to setup
 *
 * Prior to starting capture, the camera must be configured to select a
 * group of streams to be involved in the capture and their configuration.
 * The caller specifies which streams are to be involved and their configuration
 * by populating \a config.
 *
 * The configuration is created by generateConfiguration(), and adjusted by the
 * caller with CameraConfiguration::validate(). This function only accepts fully
 * valid configurations and returns an error if \a config is not valid.
 *
 * Exclusive access to the camera shall be ensured by a call to acquire() prior
 * to calling this function, otherwise an -EACCES error will be returned.
 *
 * \context This function may only be called when the camera is in the Acquired
 * or Configured state as defined in \ref camera_operation, and shall be
 * synchronized by the caller with other functions that affect the camera
 * state.
 *
 * Upon return the StreamConfiguration entries in \a config are associated with
 * Stream instances which can be retrieved with StreamConfiguration::stream().
 *
 * \return 0 on success or a negative error code otherwise
 * \retval -ENODEV The camera has been disconnected from the system
 * \retval -EACCES The camera is not in a state where it can be configured
 * \retval -EINVAL The configuration is not valid
 */

In the example application, create a new configuration variable and use the
``Camera::generateConfiguration`` function to produce a ``CameraConfiguration``
for the single ``StreamRole::Viewfinder`` role.

.. code:: cpp

   std::unique_ptr<CameraConfiguration> config = camera->generateConfiguration( { StreamRole::Viewfinder } );

The generated ``CameraConfiguration`` has a ``StreamConfiguration`` instance for
each ``StreamRole`` the application requested. Each of these has a default size
and format that the camera assigned, and a list of supported pixel formats and
sizes.

The code below accesses the first and only ``StreamConfiguration`` item in the
``CameraConfiguration`` and outputs its parameters to standard output.

.. code:: cpp

   StreamConfiguration &streamConfig = config->at(0);

With an initialized ``CameraConfiguration``, an application can make changes to
the parameters it contains, for example, to change the width and height, use the
following code:

.. code:: cpp

   streamConfig.size.width = 640;
   streamConfig.size.height = 480;

If an application changes any parameters, it must validate the configuration
before applying it to the camera using the ``CameraConfiguration::validate()``
function. If the new values are not supported by the ``Camera`` device, the
validation process adjusts the parameters to what it considers to be the closest
supported values.

The ``validate`` function returns a :doxy-pub:`CameraConfiguration::Status`
which applications shall check to see if the Pipeline Handler adjusted the

\fn CameraConfiguration::validate()
 * \brief Validate and possibly adjust the camera configuration
 *
 * This function adjusts the camera configuration to the closest valid
 * configuration and returns the validation status.
 *
 * \todo Define exactly when to return each status code. Should stream
 * parameters set to 0 by the caller be adjusted without returning Adjusted ?
 * This would potentially be useful for applications but would get in the way
 * in Camera::configure(). Do we need an extra status code to signal this ?
 *
 * \todo Handle validation of buffers count when refactoring the buffers API.
 *
 * \return A CameraConfiguration::Status value that describes the validation
 * status.
 * \retval CameraConfiguration::Invalid The configuration is invalid and can't
 * be adjusted. This may only occur in extreme cases such as when the
 * configuration is empty.
 * \retval CameraConfiguration::Adjusted The configuration has been adjusted
 * and is now valid. Parameters may have changed for any stream, and stream
 * configurations may have been removed. The caller shall check the
 * configuration carefully.
 * \retval CameraConfiguration::Valid The configuration was already valid and
 * hasn't been adjusted.

UVC configuration checks whether the validated size and FourCC match the values returned by the device. If setFormat fails, UVC configuration returns that error; if the values differ, it returns -EINVAL.
