Adjusted는 구성이 조정되어 유효해졌다는 뜻이며 어느 스트림의 매개변수든 바뀌거나 스트림 구성이 제거되었을 수 있으므로, 앱은 검증 후 크기와 픽셀 포맷을 읽고 변경을 받아들일지 판단해야 합니다. 이후 Camera::configure()는 접근이 허용되면 스트림 연결을 지우고 다시 검증하며, 결과가 Valid가 아니면 -EINVAL을 반환합니다.

catalog/fc1610ee661f8907/en.text: The app must use Camera::generateConfiguration() to create one Viewfinder configuration and check its default size and pixel format, then request 640×480 as an example and call validate(). UVC validation calls tryFormat and returns Invalid if opening the device or the test fails. Adjusted means the configuration was adjusted and is now valid; parameters for any stream may have changed, or stream configurations may have been removed. The app must therefore read the size and pixel format after validation and decide whether to accept the changes. Later, if access is allowed, Camera::configure() clears the stream associations and validates the configuration again; it returns -EINVAL if the result is not Valid.

catalog/14dc8273c52daf96.text: tryFormat은 형식을 시험하고, PipelineHandlerUVC::configure()의 setFormat은 형식을 장치에 실제로 적용하고 적용된 값을 반환합니다. UVC 구성은 검증된 크기와 FourCC가 장치에서 반환한 값과 같은지 대조하며, setFormat이 실패하면 그 오류를 반환하고 값이 다르면 -EINVAL을 반환합니다. 성공하면 UVC 구성은 스트림을 연결하고 공통 Camera::configure()는 검증된 스트림 구성을 연결된 스트림에 복사하므로, 앱은 Stream::configuration()에서 활성 구성을 읽을 수 있습니다. 대상 장치에서는 검증 전후의 크기와 픽셀 포맷, 적용 시도의 크기와 FourCC 및 반환값을 확인합니다.

catalog/14dc8273c52daf96/en.text: tryFormat tests the format, while setFormat in PipelineHandlerUVC::configure() applies the format to the device and returns the applied values. UVC configuration checks whether the validated size and FourCC match the values returned by the device. If setFormat fails, UVC configuration returns that error; if the values differ, it returns -EINVAL. On success, UVC configuration associates the stream, and the common Camera::configure() copies the validated stream configuration to the associated stream, so the app can read the active configuration from Stream::configuration(). On the target device, check the size and pixel format before and after validation, as well as the size, FourCC, and return value for the attempt to apply the format.

catalog/4bcfb5e13874fe47.text: Camera::configure()는 캡처 전에 캡처에 사용할 스트림 그룹과 각 스트림의 구성을 설정합니다. 호출자는 generateConfiguration()으로 구성을 만들고 config에 사용할 스트림과 구성을 채운 뒤 CameraConfiguration::validate()로 조정합니다. Camera::configure()에는 완전히 유효한 구성이 필요합니다.

catalog/4bcfb5e13874fe47/en.text: Camera::configure() configures the group of streams to be used for capture and the configuration of each stream before capture. The caller creates a configuration with generateConfiguration(), fills config with the streams to be used and their configurations, and then adjusts it with CameraConfiguration::validate(). Camera::configure() requires a fully valid configuration.

catalog/0779e2715d57aa3c.text: Camera::configure()는 접근 상태 검사에서 음수 오류가 나면 그 값을 반환합니다. 검사를 통과하면 각 StreamConfiguration의 이전 스트림 연결을 nullptr로 비운 뒤 validate()를 검사하고, 결과가 Valid가 아니면 -EINVAL을 반환합니다. Camera::configure()는 유효한 설정에 대해 PipelineHandler::configure를 ConnectionTypeBlocking으로 호출하고, 반환값이 0이 아니면 그 값을 그대로 반환합니다. API 계약은 함수가 반환될 때 config의 각 StreamConfiguration이 Stream 인스턴스와 연결되며 stream()으로 이를 가져올 수 있다고 설명합니다.

catalog/0779e2715d57aa3c/en.text: Camera::configure() returns the negative error value if the access state check produces one; if the check passes, it clears each StreamConfiguration's previous stream association to nullptr, checks validate(), and returns -EINVAL if the result is not Valid. For a valid configuration, Camera::configure() calls PipelineHandler::configure with ConnectionTypeBlocking and returns its return value unchanged if that value is nonzero. The API contract states that when the function returns, each StreamConfiguration in config is associated with a Stream instance, which can be retrieved with stream().

uvc-viewfinder-configuration/uvc-viewfin.text:
In the example application, create a new configuration variable and use the
``Camera::generateConfiguration`` function to produce a ``CameraConfiguration``
for the single ``StreamRole::Viewfinder`` role.

.. code:: cpp

   std::unique_ptr<CameraConfiguration> config = camera->generateConfiguration( { StreamRole::Viewfinder } );

The generated ``CameraConfiguration`` has a ``StreamConfiguration`` instance for
each ``StreamRole`` the application requested. Each of these has a default size
and format that the camera assigned, and a list of supported pixel formats and
sizes.

The code below accesses the first and only ``StreamConfiguration`` item in the
``CameraConfiguration`` and outputs its parameters to standard output.

.. code:: cpp

   StreamConfiguration &streamConfig = config->at(0);

With an initialized ``CameraConfiguration``, an application can make changes to
the parameters it contains, for example, to change the width and height, use the
following code:

.. code:: cpp

   streamConfig.size.width = 640;
   streamConfig.size.height = 480;

If an application changes any parameters, it must validate the configuration
before applying it to the camera using the ``CameraConfiguration::validate()``
function. If the new values are not supported by the ``Camera`` device, the
validation process adjusts the parameters to what it considers to be the closest
supported values.

The ``validate`` function returns a :doxy-pub:`CameraConfiguration::Status`

\fn CameraConfiguration::validate()
 * \brief Validate and possibly adjust the camera configuration
 *
 * This function adjusts the camera configuration to the closest valid
 * configuration and returns the validation status.
 *
 * \todo Define exactly when to return each status code. Should stream
 * parameters set to 0 by the caller be adjusted without returning Adjusted ?
 * This would potentially be useful for applications but would get in the way
 * in Camera::configure(). Do we need an extra status code to signal this ?
 *
 * \todo Handle validation of buffers count when refactoring the buffers API.
 *
 * \return A CameraConfiguration::Status value that describes the validation
 * status.
 * \retval CameraConfiguration::Invalid The configuration is invalid and can't
 * be adjusted. This may only occur in extreme cases such as when the
 * configuration is empty.
 * \retval CameraConfiguration::Adjusted The configuration has been adjusted
 * and is now valid. Parameters may have changed for any stream, and stream
 * configurations may have been removed. The caller shall check the
 * configuration carefully.
 * \retval CameraConfiguration::Valid The configuration was already valid and
 * hasn't been adjusted.

scenario-configure/preconditions/configu.text:
\brief Configure the camera prior to capture
 * \param[in] config The camera configurations to setup
 *
 * Prior to starting capture, the camera must be configured to select a
 * group of streams to be involved in the capture and their configuration.
 * The caller specifies which streams are to be involved and their configuration
 * by populating \a config.
 *
 * The configuration is created by generateConfiguration(), and adjusted by the
 * caller with CameraConfiguration::validate(). This function only accepts fully
 * valid configurations and returns an error if \a config is not valid.
 *
 * Exclusive access to the camera shall be ensured by a call to acquire() prior
 * to calling this function, otherwise an -EACCES error will be returned.
 *
 * \context This function may only be called when the camera is in the Acquired
 * or Configured state as defined in \ref camera_operation, and shall be
 * synchronized by the caller with other functions that affect the camera
 * state.
 *
 * Upon return the StreamConfiguration entries in \a config are associated with
 * Stream instances which can be retrieved with StreamConfiguration::stream().
 *
 * \return 0 on success or a negative error code otherwise
 * \retval -ENODEV The camera has been disconnected from the system
 * \retval -EACCES The camera is not in a state where it can be configured
 * \retval -EINVAL The configuration is not valid
 */
